This distress is further underscored by the stock trading near the absolute bottom of its annual range at just 4% of its 52-week span [E4], alongside a total absence of shareholder distributions with a 0.00% dividend yield [E3]. Operational decay is evident in the severe contraction of top-line performance, marked by a catastrophic 5-year sales growth rate of -83.1% [E51] and screen flags indicating year-over-year sales drops of -100% [E59]. This top-line collapse has finally bled into current profitability, evidenced by trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth slipping into negative territory at -7% [E18]. Conceded: [E7].
